description: ONE-TIME and usually unavailable. Returns the gift-card code only if the owner turned on 'Let the agent read card codes' for this agent, and only once: SpendTheBits never serves it to the agent again. The code is bearer money — only call this when the task genuinely needs the code (the owner already has the card in their app), and never repeat or log it.

confirm_one_time.description: Must be true: you understand the code is served once.
